summary: The branch chooser, the remote manager, Tags and the tag inspector's Push to... list cue rows beyond their edge with the always-visible scrollbar in a gutter right of their rows: at the top, the middle and the end, hovered and dragged, beside a focused and a focused+hovered row, and none where the rows fit
limitations: the Push to... list's thumb is hovered but never pressed, since on the base its place is a Push to... button, and its no-thumb case is covered by its view test only (the fixture's 13 remotes always overflow it); the middle and end are reached by Tab, so a row is focused there; wheel, track clicks and keyboard paging, 11 pt and other text sizes and window sizes, macOS, native Wayland and fractional scale factors are not covered

fixture.name: tab-lists-scroll-cues
fixture.description: the tab-reveals fixture (five commits; 30 local branches, main and topic-01 to topic-29; 30 tags v1.00 to v1.29, the even ones annotated; a local bare origin holding main, so its objects and refs are the same) and twelve more local bare remotes, mirror-01 to mirror-12, holding nothing, so the remote manager lists 13 remotes and the tag inspector 13 Push to... buttons. Nothing is fetched or pushed by the route
